experiments.procedure_text: To study the in vivo stability of 68 Ga-MSNP 2, the nanoparticle radioconjugate was injected intravenously and imaged using a small-animal PET scanner.

experiments.procedure_text: Radiolabeled B16F10 cells were injected intracardially into nude mice, and PET imaging was performed 15 minutes post-injection.
